title: Logic Model Builder
description: Interactive five-column logic model builder for public health programs. Users add Inputs, Activities, Outputs, Short-term Outcomes, and Long-term Impact cards, then connect them with directed arrows to express the program's theory of change.
creator: Introduction to Public Health
subject: public health
program planning
logic model
theory of change
health policy and management
learning_objective: Students will construct a logic model for a public health program by populating the five standard columns (Inputs, Activities, Outputs, Short-term Outcomes, Long-term Impact) and drawing the causal connections that express the program's theory of change.
